about_the_game:
This DLC contains a digital 56 pages artbook. In the artbook, you will find a collection of concept art, drawings, and sketches.
You will learn about the creative process of game development and enjoy the beautiful images of the main characters! (Some images contain adult content with fully naked girls.)

Atrbook cames in .pdf format.
